maddeler.e:
يجتاحوا (form VIII)
# يَجْتَاحُوا (yajtāḥū) /jad͡ʒ.taː.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# يُجْتَاحُوا (yujtāḥū) /jud͡ʒ.taː.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
